title: GenerateTransitionParams
description: Params of `generate.transition` (specs/09-generation.md §4.4): a short bridge across a section boundary for "Smooth with AI". `inputs.assets.before` is the end of the outgoing section (up to 8 bars) and `inputs.assets.after` the start of the incoming one (up to 8 bars). The result becomes `Transition { kind: "generated", asset, lengthTicks }` on the incoming section, played as an overlay centred on the boundary.

lengthBars.description: Bridge length in bars, centred on the boundary (09 §2: 1–4).

prompt.description: Optional user prompt; artist names are rewritten into descriptors before this point.
